description:
Publishes many pages/endpoints at once: each page in pageIds gets a new default published version and state 2 (approved/published). rootParentId (the collection's invisible root page) must also be supplied so it is marked published. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Triggers background search indexing, translation and AI SEO/meta generation, and clears the docs cache. Get ids from List Collections (rootParentId) and List Collection Pages.
Body fields:

rootParentId (string, required) - 12-char id of the collection's invisible root page (type 0).
pageIds (array<string>, required) - Non-empty array of 12-char page/endpoint ids to publish. PATCH https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/collections/:collectionId/bulkPublish
name: publish_pages
